regime: Forced selling in metals as Fed hike bets and a strong dollar push yields above 5%
takeaway: Gold fell about 3% to near $3,867 and silver about 3% to near $50 as the dollar index closed at its highest since April 2025 and the 10-year yield jumped 12 bp to 5.10%. Miners fell harder than gold (GDX −3.95%, GDXJ −4.68%), which matches the miners lagging gold and forced selling checks, and gold's one-month drop of about 6.7% keeps the short-term downtrend check in view. Tech held up better than feared after Nvidia's CEO resigned, with the Nasdaq down only 0.4%.
